name: Java sdk CI test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    name: Deploy milvus server,build and test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Deploy Milvus
        timeout-minutes: 15
        shell: bash
        working-directory: tests/milvustestv2/src/test/java/resources
        run: |
          echo "deploy milvus"
          ls
          sudo docker compose up -d

      - name: Build jar
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        working-directory:
        run: |
          echo "build jar"
          git submodule update --init
          mvn clean versions:set -DnewVersion=2.6.0
          mvn clean install -Dmaven.test.skip=true

#      - name: Test
#        timeout-minutes: 60
#        shell: bash
#        working-directory: tests/milvustestv2
#        run: |
#          echo "run testcases"
#          mvn clean test -Dsurefire.suiteXmlFiles=testng.xml

#      - name: Upload logs
#        if: ${{ always() }}
#        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
#        with:
#          name: logs-java-sdk-ci-test
#          path: |
#            tests/milvustestv2/target/surefire-reports
#            tests/milvustestv2/target/allure-results

version: '3.5'

services:
  etcd:
    container_name: milvus-javasdk-etcd
    image: quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.25
    environment:
      - ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_MODE=revision
      - ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_RETENTION=1000
      - ETCD_QUOTA_BACKEND_BYTES=4294967296
      - ETCD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT=50000
    command: etcd -advertise-client-urls=http://etcd:12379 -listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:12379 --data-dir /etcd
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "etcdctl", "--endpoints=http://localhost:12379", "endpoint", "health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3

  minio:
    container_name: milvus-javasdk-minio
    image: milvusdb/minio:RELEASE.2024-05-28T17-19-04Z
    environment:
      MINIO_ACCESS_KEY: minioadmin
      MINIO_SECRET_KEY: minioadmin
    ports:
      - "19001:9001"
      - "19000:9000"
    command: minio server /minio_data --console-address ":9001"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3

  standalone:
    container_name: milvus-javasdk-standalone
    image: milvusdb/milvus:master-20260825-dd1ee671
    user: "0:0"
    command: ["milvus", "run", "standalone"]
    security_opt:
    - seccomp:unconfined
    environment:
      ETCD_ENDPOINTS: etcd:12379
      MINIO_ADDRESS: minio:9000
      MQ_TYPE: woodpecker
      COMMON_STORAGE_USELOONFFI: "true"
      DATACOORD_COMPACTION_BUMPSCHEMAVERSION_ENABLED: "true"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:9091/healthz"]
      interval: 30s
      start_period: 90s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
    ports:
      - "29530:19530"
      - "19091:9091"
    depends_on:
      - "etcd"
      - "minio"

networks:
  default:
    name: milvus
